_how_it_works: Scene Picks: up to 3 shows from the next 7 days, shown at the top of the homepage. Picks listed here come first, in this order; any empty slots are filled automatically (PICK_RULES in index.html), so the section never goes stale even if you never touch this file. To feature a show, copy its exact 'link' and 'date' from events.json, add a short 'label', and a one-sentence 'goIf' that tells a friend what kind of night it is (the card already shows price, ages and venue). Past picks drop out on their own.

picks.label: Weeknight standout
picks.goIf: Go if you want a Tuesday that feels bigger than a Tuesday — Bayonne builds lush, looping indie-electronic songs live, layer by layer.

picks.label: Thanksgiving Eve
picks.goIf: Go if you're off Thursday and want to dance the night before Thanksgiving away — a long, extended set from one of house music's best-known DJs.

picks.label: Sunday wind-down
picks.goIf: Go if you want to end the weekend on something haunting and slow-burning — dark, heavy-hearted songs, with Cinder Well opening.
